# A section {#sec-section}

This document is a compact report, the default type.
The title block, this abstract and the body start on page 1.
The corner motif of the gold preset is in the top right corner.

# Components

::: {.callout-note}

A callout keeps its text label and the colour of its type.

:::

> Design for the reader who cannot see the colours.
>
> -- Mickaël Canouil, 2026

| Option | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `preset` | Selects the colours, fonts, style and motif. |
| `type` | Selects the document type. |
